subject.title: [TUI] Scroll-jump / auto-scroll behavior is still disruptive in 2026.3.8

question: Should TUI auto-follow be fixed as renderer behavior only, exposed as a user-visible TUI mode or setting, or both?
rationale: Source inspection supports a credible TUI render path, but changing terminal follow behavior affects default UX and may add a persisted or interactive setting, so automation should not choose the product shape alone.

options.title: Add TUI anchoring plus a visible control
options.body: Add a TUI-owned near-bottom/off/always or equivalent mode with live PTY proof, while keeping browser WebChat settings separate.

options.title: Fix only renderer jump behavior
options.body: Patch, bump, or work around the renderer so content-driven redraws do not disrupt scrollback without adding a user-facing TUI setting.

options.title: Resolve the narrow scrollback issue first
options.body: Use the narrower renderer scrollback-clearing issue as the first fix target, then revisit this broader auto-follow request with fresh terminal proof.

recommendation.title: Add TUI anchoring plus a visible control
recommendation.body: Add a TUI-owned near-bottom/off/always or equivalent mode with live PTY proof, while keeping browser WebChat settings separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs TUI UX direction, and recent history shows steipete touching TUI docs and refresh behavior adjacent to this decision.
